author: Dhruba Poudel
scope: Real local WordPress REST dispatch, permissions/nonces, admin markup and optional real WooCommerce CRUD reads. HTTP login/cookie flow, browser admin interaction and production compatibility are separate checks.

checks.name: the plugin registers a real POST REST route with its permission callback
anonymous WordPress REST dispatch cannot review snapshots
a real subscriber nonce does not substitute for the required capability
a capable administrator without a nonce is rejected
a capable administrator with an invalid nonce is rejected
actual WordPress admin REST returns the reviewed baseline report
actual WordPress dispatch reproduces the same report on retry
WordPress dispatch rejects an arbitrary remote-URL field
actual WordPress dispatch rejects JSON objects where order/event lists are required
WordPress admin markup contains the sample and accessible output boundary
real WooCommerce adapter compares exact fictional IDs without saving orders
real WooCommerce path rejects caller-supplied order overrides
real shop manager can review and remains subject to nonce checks
